game.name: Call of Duty : Black Ops (Russia)
game.desc: Call of Duty: Black Ops is a grand spectacle FPS on Xbox 360 that takes us back to 1968 and allows us to experience, through flashbacks, the peregrinations of an American soldier in the middle of the Cold War. From Vietnam to Russia via Cuba, the game follows a series of combat situations and is staged in the style of the great Hollywood war films. The game also offers a complete multiplayer mode, a Zombies mode and numerous bonuses to unlock.
